deadline.value: International applications and documents are due January 5 (priority date); later ones considered if positions remain.
deadline.quote: International student applications and supporting materials must be received by January 5.

also.quote: The priority date for admission is January 5. Applications submitted after this date will be considered if positions are still available.

gre_general.value: The department requires the GRE; recommended minimums are 152 verbal, 153 quantitative, 4 analytical.
gre_general.quote: The Department of Statistics requires the GRE for admission.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: Department normally expects TOEFL iBT 100 (also required for any financial aid); the Graduate School floor is 79.
toefl_min.quote: We normally expect a minimum TOEFL score of 100 on the Internet-based test

also.quote: All non-native English speakers who wish to be considered for financial aid of any type must demonstrate sufficient English proficiency by earning a minimum score on the TOEFL of 100 on the internet based test

ielts_min.value: Graduate School minimum IELTS 6.5 (department expects higher TOEFL for funding).

english_waiver.value: TOEFL waived only for a US undergraduate or graduate degree.
english_waiver.quote: The TOEFL requirement may be waived for a student who has received or will receive an undergraduate or graduate degree from a US institution before the start date of our program.

supervisor.value: Admissions are by a small committee; do not contact faculty directly.
supervisor.quote: Admissions are handled by a small committee, so there’s no need to contact specific faculty members directly.

funding.value: All PhD students are fully funded, usually as teaching assistants or associate instructors.
funding.quote: All of our PhD students are fully funded, generally acting as either teaching assistants or associate instructors for our undergraduate courses.

entry_route.value: Applicants should hold a bachelor's or master's degree.
entry_route.quote: Students entering the Ph.D. in Informatics, Statistics Track should have a bachelor's or master's degree from an accredited university.

notes: The Ph.D. in Statistical Science is marked sunset; applicants now enter the Ph.D. in Informatics, Statistics Track.
